description: The import pipeline: what needs importing, how a resource is imported, reimports, UIDs, and the global class list the editor and the engine read. Operations: status: which resources are outdated or failed, or one resource with resourcePath, each with its reason and a status the summary counts: needs_reimport (out of date, or a file the engine imports that has never been imported), failed, up_to_date, missing_source, or not_imported (a file the engine does not import at all, with why). Judged by content, with the checks the editor makes before a reimport: a sidecar changed since its import, as setting an option without a reimport leaves it; a sidecar with no uid or written for another file; an output under .godot/imported that is gone (missing_outputs) or changed; a source whose hash differs from the one its import recorded, or with no record. Beyond the editor, a glTF scene whose import does not depend on an image it names, because it was built before that image was imported (imported_without; a scene whose import runs an import script is not judged on images). failed is an import that failed, which the editor never tries again on its own. Without resourcePath, a sidecar whose source is gone is listed as missing_source; options (needs resourcePath): the import options of one resource; set_options (needs resourcePath, options): change import options in the sidecar, then apply them with a reimport of that resource; reimport: reimport what status says is outdated or failed, one resource with resourcePath, or what is current as well with force. Through the open editor when one serves the project, so it reloads what it holds, waiting for it to finish; otherwise through the engine's own import pass. The editor scans first, since its reimport passes over a file it has not taken in, such as one an installer has just written, and what that scan imported is not imported again unless force asks. Either takes in every file that is behind, not only the one asked for. When nothing needs reimporting, nothing runs; uid (needs resourcePath): the UID of one file and where it was read: a script's or shader's .uid file, an imported file's .import, or a scene's or resource's own header. A file with none is answered with uid null and what would give it one; refresh_uids: import the project so every script and shader has its .uid sidecar and the uid cache holds the uid of every file, scenes made with no editor among them, which a headless write names a reference by (see namedByPath), and name under uidsCreated the sidecars this made, under uidsCached the res:// files the cache has newly taken, and under stillWithoutUid the ones the engine would not import: it writes no scene and no script, so a project whose sidecars are all present is left untouched; refresh_classes: rewrite .godot/global_script_class_cache.cfg from the class_name declarations on disk. That misses the list a running editor loaded, so "added: []" means the file was already right, not that nothing is wrong: unseenByEditor names a class the editor open on this project cannot resolve, and heldBehindInEditor one it holds compiled from an older text of its file, with heldBehindUnchecked saying why when the editor did not say. lostSinceLastRebuild names a class the cache held after the last rebuild and lost before this one: the editor wrote the file without it, on a save or a scan, and will again until restarted. staleInThisEngine names a class the rebuild added, unknown to the autoloads its own engine compiles afterwards, and autoloadsOnTheRebuiltList what a second engine on that list reports of them. The tool reference in the gdharness skill, and the site, say what every field of the answer means.

force.description: reimport: reimport even what is current. Default false. Only for op reimport.

includeUpToDate.description: status: list resources that are current as well. Default false. Only for op status.

options.description: set_options: import options keyed as the .import file spells them, {"compress/mode": 1}. A dictionary option whose keys are numbers, a font's opentype_features or any option already holding number keys, takes them written as strings of digits, and opentype_features also takes an OpenType tag by its four-letter name: {"opentype_features": {"liga": 0}} turns ligatures off. Both are written as the numbers the engine reads. One already holding the value given is answered under unchanged_options rather than updated_options, and when none changed nothing is written or reimported. changed gives each option written as {was, now}. Only for op set_options.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

reimport.description: set_options: reimport afterwards, answered under reimport as project_import reimport answers. Default true. Only for op set_options.

resourcePath.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres". Only for ops status, options, set_options, uid, reimport.

timeoutMs.description: reimport, set_options: how long to wait for the editor to finish reimporting. Default 300000. Only for ops reimport, set_options.

name: project_import
title: Asset imports
